topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: The path twists, leading deeper into the forest. I follow the familiar trail, each step measured. The air is cool, carrying the scent of moss and earth. A bird calls from a distant branch. I pause, listening to the quiet melody. There is a rhythm to the forest, a steady pulse beneath the rustle of leaves. I move on, the sunlight filtering through the canopy, casting dappled shadows on the ground. The day unfolds slowly, each moment filling its own space, unhurried and sure.
